analysis: R2-c the setback population: the below-10 C finding over every automation that commands a setpoint below 10 C (post hoc)

corpus_context.note: templated setpoints are not evaluated; a literal 32-50 is below 10 C only if meant in Fahrenheit (the engine reads Celsius); neither is in the population

step1_population.rule: a literal 'temperature' or 'target_temp_low' below 10 C in the data of a climate.* action of the bound automation (vesper.edt.setback.low_setpoints); templated values cannot be read statically

step2_closed_loop.rule: a room-run cell is a caused breach when the room's minimum over days 1-2 is below 10 C with the automation and not in the same environment's baseline (no automation); setback: hours within days 1-2 that the last accepted setpoint command is below 10 C; outdoor: ERA5 2 m air temperature at the site, every 10 min over the setback
